---
title: "Julia packages"
description: |
  Julia packages developed by the group
---

Julia packages developed by the group, some of them as part of [EpiAware](https://epiaware.org). We also write [R packages](software.qmd). See also our [ongoing projects](projects.qmd) and [publications](pubs.qmd).

Packages in the Julia General registry install by name. The rest install from GitHub:

```julia
using Pkg
Pkg.add("PackageName")
Pkg.add(url = "https://github.com/owner/PackageName.jl")
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("_software.R")
```

```{r, results='asis'}
packages <- fetch_listed_packages(
  "_data/julia-packages.yml", load_team_by_github()
) |>
  tidy_packages()
hex_wall(packages)
render_packages(packages)
```
